text:
Aisha: quick thought — can we try a 5m 'regression/urgent' mini-lane inside the weekly triage? keeps main backlog flow but lets regressions get immediate owner assignment. propose we insert it around 20m in so total meeting stays ~30m.

Ben: +1 in principle. timezone note — APAC folks often can't make the 03:00 UTC slot, can we add an owner rotation to ensure someone local is responsible every other week? :eyes:

Carlos: works for me. small tweak: what about placing the mini-lane before deep dives (so we unblock infra/regressions quickly) — otherwise a regression might wait while we triage backlog.

Aisha: good point. new proposed agenda below — moved mini-lane to minute 10 so we catch regressions early.

```
Agenda (30m)
- 00:00-03:00 Rollcall + quick metrics (open incidents, new regressions)
- 03:00-10:00 Quick owners check & blockers (fast handoff)
- 10:00-15:00 Regression / urgent mini-lane (new)
- 15:00-26:00 Backlog bugs + owner assignments
- 26:00-30:00 Action items + next-week owners
```

Nina: I can take APAC owner on odd weeks. if someone can cover even weeks from NA/EU it's covered.

Jordan: I'll create a 1-page pre-read checklist and add a pinned doc for triage: what to include for regressions (steps to reproduce, last deploy, stack). will post link in #eng once done.

DevOps Bot: room booked: weekly Wed 03:00 UTC — recurring. (Reminder: change to agenda needs owner update in calendar invite)

Liam: also throwing in a suggestion — once/month add a 5m RFC quick-review slot (for low-risk design checks). doesn't need to happen every week, just a standing last-week-of-month mini item.

Ben: rotation logistics: can we switch the 'owner' flag in the triage spreadsheet to show timezone and backup? that way the calendar owner knows who to ping if they need a hand.

Carlos: agree. add a `backup` column and `timezone` column on the sheet. I'll update after this thread.

Aisha: ok i'll:
- update the calendar invite with new agenda + notes line
- add APAC rotation to owners list (Nina odd weeks)
- add RFC quick-review as monthly slot
- Jordan — please post the pre-read link and i'll pin it in the invite

Jordan: will do, posting in 15m: https://redwood.internal/docs/triage-pre-read-template :paperclip:

Ben: cool. can we do a 2-week trial and revisit? if the mini-lane creates churn we can tweak. :thumbsup:

Aisha: 2-week trial sounds perfect. I'll update invite now and ping folks when it's live. thanks all! :sparkles:
